D: A stolen diamond, a crooked boxing promoter and a dog all collide in London's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when the dog swallows the squeaky toy.
S: East End pie, mash and parsley liquor

Little minced beef and onion pies with a flaky lid, a scoop of buttery mash and bright green parsley liquor, with chilli vinegar to splash on. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, add 1 tbsp flour and 200ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes, then cool. Line 8 muffin holes with shortcrust, fill and top with puff. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Mash 800g potatoes with 50g butter. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml stock and simmer, then add a bunch of finely chopped parsley. Serve with malt vinegar and chilli.
Cheddar, Red Leicester and Wensleydale diamonds with crackers and pickled onions
Aged cheddar, red Leicester and a crumbly Wensleydale cut into sharp little diamond shapes, with crackers and pickled onions.
Browned chipolatas glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard, on toothpicks
Thin pork sausages grilled until sticky, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard, served on toothpicks.
M: Bacon, sausage, eggs, black pudding, mushrooms, beans, tomato and buttered toast
Bacon, sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, black pudding, mushrooms and grilled tomato with buttered toast.
Avi's New York strip and creamed spinach
Avi, who can't wait to get out of London

Thick sirloin seared hard and rested, with a buttery baked potato, garlicky creamed spinach and a sharp horseradish cream, the way Avi orders back home. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 thick sirloins and sear in a smoking pan 3 to 4 minutes a side to 54C inside, then rest. Wilt 400g spinach with a crushed garlic clove, add 150ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce until thick. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish. Split the potatoes, add butter and serve with the steak.
W: Caramel and sliced banana on a biscuit crust, topped with whipped cream
Biscuit base, thick caramel and sliced bananas under a mountain of cream and grated chocolate.
K: Irish whiskey, lime and ginger beer over ice

Irish whiskey over ice topped with fiery ginger beer and fresh lime, with a long ginger and lime garnish. A proper fighter's drink. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Irish whiskey and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.

note.text: No more bets, boys. The dog ate the squeaky toy, the diamond is gone, and I need a cup of tea.

winks: The dog that swallowed the squeaky toy

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut each cheese into sharp little diamond shapes.
Arrange on a board with crackers and pickled onions. Don't swallow any of the diamonds.
Toss in a hot pan with honey and mustard until sticky.
Spear on toothpicks and serve hot. Do you like dags?
Grill the halved tomatoes alongside and warm the beans.
Fry the black pudding and mushrooms, then the eggs.
Make buttered toast and serve everything together.
Crush the biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into a pie dish.
Spread with the caramel and layer sliced bananas on top.
Whip the cream and spread over.
Chill to set, then grate the chocolate over.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add whiskey and lime juice to each.
Top with cold ginger beer and stir once.
Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.

s.note: Cheddar, Red Leicester and Wensleydale diamonds with crackers and pickled onions
s.how: Cut 150g aged cheddar, 150g Red Leicester and 150g Wensleydale into sharp little diamond shapes. Arrange on a board with crackers and pickled onions. Don't swallow any of the diamonds.

s.note: Browned chipolatas glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard, on toothpicks
s.how: Grill 500g chipolatas until browned. Toss in a hot pan with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard until sticky. Spear on toothpicks and serve hot. Do you like dags?

m.note: Bacon, sausage, eggs, black pudding, mushrooms, beans, tomato and buttered toast
m.how: Grill 8 rashers bacon and 4 pork sausages. Fry 4 eggs, 4 slices black pudding and 200g mushrooms. Warm a tin of baked beans and grill 2 halved tomatoes. Serve with buttered toast.

w.note: Caramel and sliced banana on a biscuit crust, topped with whipped cream
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits mixed with 120g melted butter into a pie dish and chill. Spread with 380g tinned caramel, layer 3 sliced bananas, top with 300ml whipped cream and grated chocolate.

d.note: Irish whiskey, lime and ginger beer over ice
d.how: Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Irish whiskey and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.
